runtime.result: No new runtime trace was run; the available runtime corpus cannot separate these architecture-level hypotheses.
runtime.historical_negative: Cell-stage probes did not fire because the recorded run never entered the Cell stage; no mode transition, editor, or space transition trace exists.

method.name: nine-step adversarial static investigation
steps: State exact predictions for each hypothesis.
Collect direct Ghidra body, table, constructor, xref, and call-graph evidence.
Collect independent historical evidence without treating repeated copies as independent.
Mark support, contradiction, and neutral evidence.
Identify whether architecture changes if the hypothesis is selected.
Perform the smallest distinguishing static observation available.
Record runtime feasibility and negative evidence without fabrication.
Adjudicate only the minimum semantics that the evidence safely requires.

taxonomy.meaning: A preferred bounded architecture claim is adopted, while original transport timing, payload semantics, and ABI details remain open.

hypotheses.claim: A single global mode enum/state machine owns App, Simulator, input, SpaceContext, scenario, and Cell state.
predictions: The same field/value or same transition would be read or written by the App manager, input manager, SpacePlayerData, scenario mode, and Cell lifecycle.
A SpaceContext value would be an alias of the App active mode or scenario mode.
The 27-slot concrete Cell table could be treated as the universal IGameMode ABI.
against: The App manager active index is at cGameModeManager+0x28 and is guarded by a mode-entry vector.
Simulator cStrategy has independent last/current/pending fields at +0x0c/+0x10/+0x14/+0x18.
cGameInputManager has independent last/current mode fields at +0x18/+0x1c and separate input-region state.
SpaceContext is stored independently at SpacePlayerData+0x10 with values None=-1, Planet=0, SolarSystem=1, Galaxy=2.
cScenarioMode::mMode is documented at +0xcc with UnkMode/EditMode/PlayMode values; it is not the same owner as SpaceContext.
hypotheses.independence: The direct field-owner and owner-specific writer evidence is independent across App, Simulator, input, SpacePlayerData, and scenario artifacts; repeated summaries are not counted again.

hypotheses.claim: OpenSpore needs separate explicit state machines/axes, with an App mode registry and a Simulator strategy pending/commit bridge rather than one global mode.
predictions: The App registry performs range validation and ordered old-exit/new-enter callbacks.
The Simulator strategy retains a first pending request and separate last/current committed IDs.
A mode announcement can be sent/requested through a message boundary without proving immediate listener execution.
Input routing, space navigation, scenario mode, and Cell lifecycle remain independently addressable.
support: Direct App helper disassembly at 0x007d85b0 proves the callback/message order.
Direct strategy constructor and stable-predicate bodies plus historical disassembly establish pending/commit state.
Direct 0x00b63510 dispatch reads two announcement words, normalizes them, suppresses equal IDs, and selects exit/enter paths.
Direct SpaceContext setter/initialization and independent historical scenario/input field maps establish separate owners.
against: No positive runtime trace proves which listeners execute between the two App sends and the new OnEnter.
The semantic names of opaque mode IDs and the full scenario/input routing bodies remain incomplete.
hypotheses.independence: App helper, strategy constructor/commit helpers, message listener, SpaceContext body, and field-map evidence are separate evidence surfaces; the same claim repeated in multiple reports is treated as one historical source family.

hypotheses.claim: The original transition is a single synchronous global state machine: both mode announcements are sent/requested before the new OnEnter can run.
predictions: The MessageSend implementation would directly invoke the listener before returning to 0x007d85b0.
The exit message would synchronously commit last mode before the helper writes/enters the new mode.
A queue processor would not be needed between the two sends.
support: The App helper invokes the message-manager vtable slot directly between old OnExit and new OnEnter.
The old index is written before the exit send and the new OnEnter follows the exit send.
against: The concrete MessageSend body and listener callback timing were not recovered as a complete chain.
The message manager has separate MessagePost/MessagePostFunction bodies that insert records through 0x00885710, and queue processing is separate at 0x008841f0/0x00847f0.
No ProcessQueue call occurs inside the App helper; that proves only helper-local ordering, not listener execution timing.
hypotheses.independence: The helper call order is direct disassembly. The queue implementation is a separate message-manager body, so the unresolved timing result is not merely a repeated wording of the helper evidence.

hypotheses.claim: The Simulator strategy requires a pending request slot with first-request-wins, then separate last/current commits.
predictions: The constructor initializes last, current, and pending IDs to -1 and pending path to 0.
A request path writes its path value but overwrites the pending ID only when the pending ID is -1.
Commit-last and commit-current copy the pending ID, clear it, and reset the path to 0.
A stable-mode predicate requires both committed IDs to equal the candidate and no pending request.
support: Direct 0x00b5b960 constructor decompilation writes -1 to +0x0c/+0x10/+0x14 and 0 to +0x18.
Read-only instruction search finds the first-request guards at 0x00b5b880 and 0x00b5b8a0; historical disassembly pins the commit helpers at 0x00b5b8c0 and 0x00b5b8e0.
Direct 0x00b5b840 disassembly checks both committed IDs and pending -1.
against: The request/commit helpers are table targets/interior code in the current Ghidra function map rather than separately named functions; their historical disassembly is retained as static evidence.
The listener's direct calls are broader transition/effect bodies at 0x00b5f040 and 0x00b5dbb0, so exact ownership of every committed-field write is bounded.
hypotheses.independence: Constructor, stable predicate, table placement, and historical helper disassembly are distinct. The repeated state-machine report is supporting corroboration, not an independent body.

hypotheses.claim: The SDK IGameMode contract is a semantic lifecycle/input/update reference; the corrected Cell tables are concrete ABI evidence, not a universal interface ABI or a clean-room ABI requirement.
predictions: IGameMode has 16 slots with Initialize at slot 4, Dispose at 5, OnEnter at 6, OnExit at 7, input at 9-14, and Update at 15.
The Cell primary/secondary table pair contains additional concrete slots and has named lifecycle methods at different offsets.
The editor candidate has a first 16-slot prefix matching IGameMode but continues with additional editor virtuals.
support: The editor constructor at 0x0057ce80 writes 0x013f57f8 as the first vptr; the 0x013f57f8 table begins with the 16-slot IGameMode-shaped prefix.
The Cell construction helper at 0x00e616c0 writes primary vptr 0x01485558 and secondary vptr 0x01485550 into a 0x0c-byte object.
The Cell table has named Initialize/Dispose/OnEnter/OnExit/input/Update targets at concrete slots and additional entries.
The committed conflict record explicitly preserves the 16-slot versus 27-slot distinction.
against: The concrete table owners and all unknown slots are not fully typed, and SporeApp.exe has no MSVC RTTI.
The 0x01485558/0x01485550 labels must follow the construction evidence rather than historical table-count shorthand.
hypotheses.independence: Constructor stores, raw table bytes, named slot bodies, and SDK interface layout are independent dimensions; a vtable candidate label alone is not treated as proof.

hypotheses.claim: SpaceContext, scenario mode, input mode, and App mode are orthogonal axes; their numeric overlap is not aliasing.
predictions: SpaceContext Galaxy=2 must not imply scenario PlayMode=2.
An App active-index change must not overwrite input last/current fields or SpacePlayerData+0x10.
Same-value suppression in the SpaceContext setter must remain local to that axis.
support: Direct 0x01021960 only stores at SpacePlayerData+0x10 when the value changes and has a conditional Galaxy follow-up.
Historical field evidence places cScenarioMode::mMode at +0xcc and cGameInputManager mode fields at +0x18/+0x1c.
The App helper only reads/writes its own manager entry vector and active index.
against: The scenario field is SDK/layout evidence rather than a fully recovered native scenario state machine.
Input routing regions and listener priority remain unresolved.
hypotheses.independence: The Space setter is direct body evidence; scenario/input field owners are independent structural evidence; no numeric coincidence is used as dataflow proof.

predictions.prediction: 0x007d8c80 is a validated indexed request; 0x007d85b0 owns the ordered transition.
predictions.result: Supported. 0x007d8c80 range-checks and calls the helper; 0x007d85b0 performs old OnExit, index write, exit send, new OnEnter, enter send.

predictions.prediction: The stale SDK label at 0x007d8d40 is not the concrete activation body.
predictions.result: Supported. 0x007d8d40 rewrites base vtables/clears entries; 0x01412598 directly references 0x007d8c80 at the activation slot and 0x007d8360 at the name slot.

predictions.prediction: The corrected Cell primary/secondary vptr order is observable at object construction.
predictions.result: Supported. The body stores 0x01485558 at object+0 and 0x01485550 at object+4.

predictions.prediction: The editor candidate has a 16-slot IGameMode prefix plus additional editor virtuals.
predictions.result: Supported. The constructor stores 0x013f57f8 and the table has the SDK-shaped prefix followed by additional slots.

predictions.prediction: Pending state is first-request-wins and commits are last/current separate.
predictions.result: Supported for the mechanics; exact mode-ID semantics remain opaque.

predictions.prediction: The listener is an event bridge rather than the App registry itself.
predictions.result: Supported. It receives the two mode IDs, normalizes payload words, suppresses equal normalized IDs, and selects exit/enter-specific bodies. Exact listener execution timing remains unresolved.

predictions.prediction: SpaceContext has its own initialization, conditional setter, and independent writer.
predictions.result: Supported. Context values and owner are independent of App/Simulator mode fields.

evidence_for.claim: The helper calls old slot +0x1c, writes +0x28, invokes the manager message slot with 0x0212d3e7, calls new slot +0x18, then invokes the slot with 0x022d1adc.
Negative and upper-bound checks reject invalid indices; valid requests call 0x007d85b0; the same-index path is handled in the helper.
The concrete manager table has activation and name-request entries and is referenced by the manager construction/transition bodies.
The Cell object is allocated as 0x0c bytes and receives primary 0x01485558 plus secondary 0x01485550 vptrs before registration as Game_Cell.
The editor constructor installs 0x013f57f8 at the first object vptr and several additional editor vptrs.
The listener recognizes 0x0212d3e7/0x022d1adc, reads payload +0x08/+0x10, normalizes via 0x00b5c9d0, suppresses equal IDs, and selects exit/enter paths.
The strategy initializes pending/committed slots and requires equal committed IDs plus no pending request for stability.
The input-manager accessor returns DAT_0167eaf8, a distinct global service pointer.
The SpaceContext setter stores only on a changed value and has a separate Galaxy-only follow-up.
Request helpers preserve the first pending ID; commit helpers copy to last/current and clear pending state.
The SDK interface and concrete input/mode object dimensions are separate contracts.

evidence_against.claim: The SDK-named SetActiveModeAt address is a teardown/vtable-clearing body, contradicting the stale address label.
Post-style paths enqueue records and queue processing is separate; the complete MessageSend listener timing is not recovered.
No positive mode/editor/space transition trace exists; Cell probes are negative because Cell was not reached.
Concrete tables have unknown slots and no RTTI; candidate owner identity must not be expanded into a complete C++ hierarchy.

recovered_binary_evidence: The App helper's local order is old OnExit, active-index write, exit-message send/request, new OnEnter, and enter-message send/request.
The indexed request guard, same-index no-op, and concrete teardown-versus-activation address conflict are recovered.
The Simulator strategy's pending, last, and current state mechanics and first-request-wins guard are recovered.
Cell/editor constructor stores, table contents, slot names, vptr addresses, and table ordering are recovered as binary evidence.
SpaceContext and scenario/input field ownership are recovered at their original owners.
clean_room_requirements: Keep App, Simulator strategy, input, SpaceContext, scenario, and Cell state as separate axes.
Provide a request/command boundary with validated requests and explicit transition phases.
Preserve the semantic lifecycle/input/update surface without requiring the original concrete dispatch ABI.
Make first-request-wins explicit for any strategy pending channel retained by OpenSpore.
Make send/request and listener-execution timing explicit in the clean-room boundary; do not infer it from binary send order.
not_required_from_binary: Raw Cell vptr addresses or primary/secondary vtable addresses.
Raw vtable ordering, table size, or original slot numbers.
The original concrete Cell or editor dispatch ABI.
The original opaque message payload layout or listener timing.
The original mode-ID numeric values as OpenSpore public identifiers.

independence_repetition.basis: Direct Ghidra disassembly at 0x007d85b0 plus separate vtable/xref and decompilation evidence.
Constructor, stable predicate, table placement, and historical helper disassembly are separate observations.
SDK interface layout, raw table bytes, constructor stores, and named slot bodies.
Distinct field owners and direct Space setter; no shared dataflow is inferred from fan-in.
The same state-machine/event-map findings copied across committed reports are corroboration/provenance, not additional independent observations.
SDK offsets/names corroborate layout but do not independently prove native behavior or runtime reachability.

separating_observation.smallest_static_observation: Read-only construction and table inspection at 0x00e616c0, 0x0057ce80, 0x00b5b960, and the direct helper/listener disassembly.
separating_observation.result: The architecture-level axes are separated even though message send/requested and listener-execution timing, payload semantics, and runtime reachability remain unresolved.
separates: single global state machine versus App plus Simulator bridge
16-slot semantic interface versus concrete Cell/editor ABI
same request manager versus first-request-wins strategy pending
SpaceContext/scenario/input/App numeric coincidence versus owner-specific state
separating_observation.runtime_observation: Not performed; historical runtime cannot separate the hypotheses because it never reaches a mode transition and no synthetic-input path is available.

app_mode_activation.action: Reject negative/out-of-range index; valid request delegates to helper. Same index is a no-op in helper.
If current index is valid, call old mode virtual slot +0x1c (OnExit) and capture old mode ID.
Invoke message-manager vtable +0x14 with 0x0212d3e7 and a local transition payload.
Invoke message-manager vtable +0x14 with 0x022d1adc and the new/old mode words.

app_name_request.action: Scan 24-byte ModeEntry records, compare names case-insensitively, and call vtable +0x40 SetActiveModeAt on match.

simulator_strategy.action: Set last/current/pending IDs to -1 and pending path to 0.
Set path 1/2; store identifier only if pending ID is -1 (first request wins).
Copy pending ID to last/current, clear pending ID to -1, and reset path to 0.
Stable only when candidate equals both committed IDs and no pending request exists.

announcement_listener.action: Recognize mode exit/enter IDs and read payload words at +0x08/+0x10.
Normalize both mode words; equal normalized IDs return without commit behavior.
Select exit- or enter-specific transition/commit path. The bodies are broader than the two state-field writes; exact effect ordering remains bounded.

message_transport.action: Directly call message-manager vtable +0x14; helper-local call order is exact.
Post-style paths package records and insert them into manager storage; this is separate from the App helper's concrete send implementation.
Process queue records and release referenced objects. Exact listener priority, tie order, reentrancy, and whether MessageSend invokes immediately remain unresolved.

space_context.action: If changed, write requested context; Galaxy value 2 may invoke a conditional follow-up.
On one-shot initialization, may force context 0 directly; this is not App mode selection.

input_axis.action: Return the independent DAT_0167eaf8 cGameInputManager pointer.
Maintain last/current mode fields plus mouse/input-region state; exact router and listener order remain unresolved.
Cell mode consumes key/mouse callbacks and performs mode-specific routing; this is downstream of the input manager, not proof of the manager's complete algorithm.

cell_and_editor.action: Install corrected primary 0x01485558 and secondary 0x01485550 vptrs.
Concrete Cell slots cover initialize, enter, exit, dispose, update, and input; they are not a universal IGameMode ABI.
Install 0x013f57f8 as the first editor vptr; first 16 slots match IGameMode and later slots remain editor-specific.

resolution.preferred_claim: Keep App mode orchestration, Simulator pending/committed strategy state, input mode, SpaceContext, scenario mode, and Cell lifecycle as distinct axes; model mode requests and transition phases explicitly.
resolution.limit: The original message send/requested and listener-execution timing, payload mapping, complete input-region routing, scenario native body, and runtime reachability are unresolved.
preserved_alternatives: The concrete Cell tables remain structural/ABI evidence with unknown slots rather than a complete IGameMode interface.
The 0x01485558/0x01485550 primary/secondary interpretation follows construction stores while exact table ownership/slot names remain bounded.
The 0x013f57f8 editor candidate is supported as a concrete root, not as proof of a 29-slot IGameMode ABI.
The direct App send order is exact, but immediate versus queued listener execution is not selected.

explicit_state_machine.scope: At least App registry transition state and Simulator strategy pending/committed state; not one global enum.

command_request_layer.scope: Mode requests by index/name with invalid and same-state no-op behavior; the request must be separated from lifecycle effects.

transition_timing.scope: The recovered helper-local order is evidence, not a requirement to reproduce the original ABI or transport. OpenSpore must define deterministic transition phases and make the relationship between lifecycle callbacks and sent/requested notifications explicit; it may use a different internal callback/notification design.

first_request_wins.scope: Required for the Simulator strategy pending slot. The App registry separately has same-index no-op behavior; these are not the same rule.

axes: input manager mode and input-region state

not_required: Raw Cell vptr addresses, primary/secondary table addresses, and vtable ordering
Original 27-slot Cell ABI as an OpenSpore public interface
Original concrete slot numbers or raw table size

exact_decisions_dependent.depends_on: Separate App registry and Simulator strategy bridge.
exact_decisions_dependent.architectural_consequence_if_wrong: Input/world/Cell consumers can be routed through the wrong owner or state.

exact_decisions_dependent.depends_on: Validated index/name requests with same-request no-op and explicit transition phases.
exact_decisions_dependent.architectural_consequence_if_wrong: Re-entry, invalid requests, and lifecycle callbacks can be duplicated or skipped.

exact_decisions_dependent.depends_on: Ordered exit/enter notifications around new OnEnter, with send/requested and listener-execution timing explicit but not overclaimed.
exact_decisions_dependent.architectural_consequence_if_wrong: Listeners may commit or render against the wrong active mode.

exact_decisions_dependent.depends_on: Pending first-request-wins plus separate last/current commits.
exact_decisions_dependent.architectural_consequence_if_wrong: A rapid sequence of mode requests can overwrite the pending transition incorrectly.

exact_decisions_dependent.depends_on: Use the IGameMode lifecycle/input/update surface as a semantic reference, without requiring the original 16-slot shape, slot numbers, or concrete table addresses in OpenSpore.
exact_decisions_dependent.architectural_consequence_if_wrong: The replacement may conflate semantic lifecycle/input callbacks with raw Cell/editor dispatch and lose the clean-room boundary.

exact_decisions_dependent.depends_on: Keep SpaceContext, scenario mode, and input mode as independent axes.
exact_decisions_dependent.architectural_consequence_if_wrong: Numeric aliases such as Galaxy=2 and PlayMode=2 can corrupt unrelated transitions.

safe_to_freeze: App active-index ownership and validated index/name request boundaries.
The recovered helper-local order as evidence: old OnExit -> active-index write -> exit send/request -> new OnEnter -> enter send/request; do not freeze the original transport or ABI.
Separate App mode registry and Simulator strategy pending/committed state.
First-request-wins semantics for the Simulator strategy pending slot.
IGameMode lifecycle/input/update semantics: Initialize, Dispose, OnEnter, OnExit, input callbacks, Update, without freezing original slot numbers.
SpaceContext as an independent navigation axis and scenario/input mode as separate axes.
Use explicit transition events/commands in the clean-room architecture without requiring the original payload ABI, vptr addresses, table order, or slot numbers.
deferral_list: Whether the App MessageSend slot invokes listeners synchronously or through a queue.
Exact mode-announcement payload words and opaque mode-ID normalization semantics.
Message listener priority direction, tie order, consume-result behavior, reentrancy, cancellation, and release timing.
Concrete cGameInputManager vtable base and complete input-region routing algorithm.
Complete cScenarioMode native state machine and all scenario producer/consumer paths.
All unknown slots and exact inheritance of the corrected Cell primary/secondary tables.
Duplicate App mode names, active-entry removal, and first-request producer from the main menu.
Runtime order/reachability for App, Cell, editor, and space transitions.
Original fixed-step behavior; SDK SetFixedStepping is not connected to observed pacing.
blockers: No positive runtime trace reaches a gameplay mode transition; the available headless path cannot inject input.
The concrete MessageSend body and listener callback timing are not fully recovered.
Scenario and input state owners are field-supported but their complete transition bodies are incomplete.
No MSVC RTTI exists, so table candidates require constructor/xref corroboration and cannot be promoted solely by names.
